executive_summary.verdict: INVALID TEST — do not action. Spend ($57.97) is 5.8% of the committed pilot budget, zero purchases or checkouts were recorded across an 11-day window, and 4 of 16 matrix cells never delivered at all. The blocking issues are operational (tracking + delivery), not creative or audience quality, and must be fixed before this sprint can produce a usable read on avatar, PMF, or variable-stack performance.
executive_summary.avatar_pmf_read: Not evaluable this cycle. All four ICPs (GiftGiver45, Milestone2534, HometownSelf, MemoryKeeperCouple) have at least one cell with zero delivery, so no avatar can be fairly compared to the others yet. The one persistent signal worth carrying forward: recorded spend still skews ~66% toward the 45+ segment, which was the exact problem the pre-pilot CBO/targeting fix was meant to solve — worth a direct look at current campaign-level targeting settings, independent of the MST creative read.
executive_summary.communications_read: Not evaluable — no conversion signal exists to judge message-market fit of any headline, hook, or proof treatment. The only directional (non-verdict) click signal: C3A ("Look closer. Those are real street names.", 5.3% link CTR on 151 impressions) and C1B ("What do you give someone who has everything?", 2.1% CTR) are the only cells with any above-baseline engagement — noted for visibility, explicitly not a basis for action.
executive_summary.variable_stack_read: Not evaluable — see winning_variable_stack. All prior hypotheses (row isolation, diagonal reads) remain hypotheses; none can be promoted or retired on this data.
executive_summary.audience_performance_read: Reach and impressions concentrate in the 45-54 and 55-64 male segments; ~66% of the $57.97 recorded spend sits in 45+ across genders. Traffic volume overall is too low (1,951 impressions, 23-341 link clicks depending on which export you trust) for any audience-segment conversion comparison.

failure_patterns.diagnosis: technical — zero ad delivery for the full 11-day window; not a creative or audience failure. Check ad status/approval/budget delivery in Ads Manager.

technical — Initiate Checkout event does not appear to be firing (0 checkouts_initiated account-wide despite non-zero link clicks and, per the device export, non-zero add-to-cart activity). Flagged 2026-07-17, appears unresolved.

The demographic and device/placement exports disagree on link clicks (23 vs 341) and adds-to-cart (0 vs 7) by a wide margin. Neither figure should be treated as ground truth until reconciled with an unbroken account-level export.

carried_forward_hypotheses: Row A (TN_Assertive) isolates on quality/craft-led assertive tone across all four ICPs.
Row B (PR_Testimonial) isolates on unattributed customer-quote proof across all four ICPs.
Row C (HP_ForgettableGift) isolates on the forgettable/generic-gift pain point across all four ICPs.
Row D (CTA_ClaimOffer) isolates on offer-as-closer, never as hook, across all four ICPs.

Main diagonal (C1A/C2B/C3C/C4D) and counter-diagonal (C1D/C2C/C3B/C4A) are the highest-confidence isolation read once live — but C3C sits on the main diagonal and has zero delivery, and C4A is live only under the naming anomaly, so neither diagonal is currently clean.
